simple.summary: אֱלוּל (ʼĔlûwl) means Elul , the sixth Jewish month First listed occurrence: Neh 6 15.

definitions.full: H435. Elul I. אֱלוּל proper name of 6th month, Aug.—Sept. Neh 6:15 (Mishna id. , Palestinian אלול , Vog 79 , Assyrian Ululu COT 1:1 , Arabic , Aramaic ).
